root.label: Brookings analysis of care services in climate adaptation plans

events.label: Brookings analysis of care services in climate adaptation plans

slots.name: sample documents
slots.sentence: Of the 103 English-language adaptation documents, six were not machine-readable. The final sample comprises 97 NAPs and NDCs.

slots.name: care coverage
slots.sentence: Overall, 85% of the 97 plans include at least one reference to care recipients, the care workforce, or care-related infrastructure and services.

slots.name: ECEC absence
slots.sentence: ECEC is absent from 96 of 97 plans: Only the Philippines explicitly references day care centers for displaced families.

slots.name: DRR plans
slots.sentence: Twenty-one plans address care within DRR activities.

slots.name: housing activities
slots.sentence: Housing is addressed in 160 activities across 39 plans.

slots.name: disability activities
slots.sentence: Eighteen plans mention activities for people with disabilities, comprising ninety-four activities.

slots.name: older activities
slots.sentence: Fifty-nine activities mention older people across 24 plans.

slots.name: health training plans
slots.sentence: As for activities, 35 plans mention training health workers; six aim to expand the health workforce; and 38 propose hospital upgrades.
